auditSample.textSample: Date night in Vienna! We went to The Prater, an amusement park that has a history dating back to the 16th century. It was first opened as a recreational space, literally meadows and a hunting ground and initially was restricted to use by the nobility. In the 1600’s the Prater was opened to all. Over the years it evolved with the opening of inns and restaurants and eventually 'amusements’. There are so many things to love about The Prater - first of all, there is no fee to enter!
